programme.title: Basketball - Eurocup: Siauliai - Tenerife
programme.desc: Eurocup was created in 2002 as the second competition of Euroleague Basketball. The strongest basketball clubs that fail to qualify for the Euroleague compete in this competition, and mostly clubs from the top 15 strongest European leagues participate in it. Placement in the Eurocup is secured through national championships and cups, and through invitations to the so-called wildcards. The second strongest competition in European basketball was created by the merger of the FIBA ​​Radivoje Korać Cup and the Saporta Cup. The significance of this competition is that the winner secures the right to participate in the next season in the strongest club basketball competition in Europe, the Euroleague.

programme.title: Košarka - ABA liga: Cibona - FMP
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season.

programme.title: Basket 3x3 - World Tour: Zaisan, grupna faza
programme.desc: Fiba World Tour 3 na 3 za razliku od World Cupa uključuje momčadi iz pojedinih gradova dok na World Cup pravo natjecanja imaju nacionalni timovi. Kao vrhunac 3 na 3 košarke World Tour natjecanje pod okriljem Fibe od 2012. godine mami uzdahe ljubitelja ovog dinamičnog sporta. Temeljna razlika između klasične dvoranske košarke je broj igrača na terenu, a to je po tri u svakoj momčadi. Bitne razlike su još, da se igra na polovici standardnog košarkaškog terena na jedan koš. Utakmica traje deset minuta ili ukoliko jedna momčad prva dođe do 21 poena meč se automatski prekida.
